title: Theory of Mind and Persuasion Beyond Conversation: Assessing the Capacity of LLMs to Induce Belief States via Planning and Action
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating cognitive capabilities, specifically Theory of Mind (ToM) and planning to induce belief states in others. While it mentions safety, alignment, and manipulation risks as motivations for the study, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral systems, or ethical reasoning frameworks.
